scientific_limitations: The embedding is the minimal Pluecker embedding.
The result determines the first two polar degrees, not the full polar vector.
Projective-space cases k=1 and k=n-1 are excluded because the standard Hurwitz theorem assumes degree at least two.
An unindexed source could contain the same short Grassmannian specialization.
